South West Arrow With Hook Symbol

There is no legacy Windows Alt code for South West Arrow With Hook because it is not in either the OEM code page 437 or Windows-1252 tables. The Unicode codepoint is U+2926, which you can use as ⤦ in HTML, \2926 in CSS, or type with Alt+10534 on Windows (BMP only). If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly. South West Arrow With Hook is outside both legacy code pages, which is why U+2926 is the identifier that works across Word, HTML, CSS, Python and JavaScript. South West Arrow With Hook has no named HTML entity, so use the numeric escape ⤦ or the hex escape ⤦.

How to type south west arrow with hook on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 1 0 5 3 4 on the numeric keypad for the decimal codepoint 10534.
  4. Release Alt. The South West Arrow With Hook character (⤦) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type south west arrow with hook on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for South West Arrow With Hook. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "South West Arrow With Hook" and click the character to insert it.

How to use south west arrow with hook in code

  • HTML: or
  • CSS: content:"\2926"; ()
  • Python: \u2926 or chr(0x2926)
  • JavaScript: \u2926 or String.fromCodePoint(0x2926)
  • JSON: "\u2926"

Frequently asked questions

Is there an Alt code for ⤦?

No legacy Alt code exists for South West Arrow With Hook because it is not in code page 437 or Windows-1252. Use the Unicode codepoint U+2926 in HTML, CSS or the Character Viewer instead.

How do I type ⤦ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ⤦, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+10534 not work?

Alt+10534 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for South West Arrow With Hook?

The Unicode codepoint for South West Arrow With Hook is U+2926. You can use this value in HTML as ⤦, in CSS as \2926, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ⤦ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+2926, then click it.
